why: Drops one layer from the population `activePanelContainer` derives, which is the defect this derivation exists to make impossible. Twice a pane shipped missing from the hand-kept list it replaced -- the gallery workbench (#730, missed by #741) and the match-failure overlay (#325, fixed in #912) -- and both had the same symptom: arrows moved nothing inside the pane and Confirm landed nowhere, with every required check green. The sweep walks every `HudLayerId`, so whichever layer falls off the end is the one that fails.
killedBy: every HUD layer is reachable by arrows and by a D-pad (issue #914) gives the pad the keyboard inside confirm-new-campaign
